maddeler.e:
يتراءون (form VI)
# يَتَرَاءَوْنَ (yatarāʔawna) /ja.ta.raː.ʔaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
# يُتَرَاءَوْنَ (yutarāʔawna) /ju.ta.raː.ʔaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
